name: final_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd(); exclusions={'MANIFEST.json':'Self-exclusion: including its own bytes would require a circular hash.','final_manifest.receipt.json':'Terminal wrapper receipt is created only after this child exits; explicitly excluded to avoid circular command/manifest receipt dependency.','final_manifest.output.txt':'Terminal wrapper output is created only after this child exits; explicitly excluded to avoid circular hash dependency.'};files=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 assert not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
 if not p.is_file():continue
 n=str(p.relative_to(lane))
 if n in exclusions:continue
 b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':n,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
assert any(x['path']=='frozen-after.json' for x in files)
m={'lane':str(lane),'files':files,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':exclusions,'completed_wrapper_receipts_included':[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')],'all_other_receipt_json_included':[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('receipt.json')],'scope':'Actual own-lane bytes including helpers, frozen inputs, all handoff files, completed receipt JSONs, source payloads, plans, live search states, responses and guard hashchain. No peer traversal. Final receipt/output are genuine wrapper artifacts with named terminal exclusions.'}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(m,indent=2),capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'completed_wrapper_receipts':len(m['completed_wrapper_receipts_included']),'frozen_after':json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text()).get('mismatches'),'exclusions':list(exclusions),'credit':0}))
